items.heading: Explains that garment and palace separated from root-soul-body and became surrounding lights, and also explanations of Adam Kadmon and ABYA, and NRNHY, and Av-Sag-Mah-Ban. And it contains eight matters: — 1. Root-soul-body are attached to one another. Garment and palace separated from them. 2. Root-soul-body are inner vessels, in which the more external is more inferior. Garment and palace are surrounding vessels, in which the more external is more important, and therefore the shells are found between the body and the garments, which is the place of darkness and greater inferiority. 3. When the countenances of Adam Kadmon and ABYA clothe one within another, each clothes only in three discernments: root-soul-body, which are attached together, and the ten Sefirot of the bodies do not clothe in the ten Sefirot of the garments. 4. Root-soul-body of Adam Kadmon clothe within root-soul-body of Atik of Atzilut, and root-soul-body of Atik of Atzilut clothe in root-soul-body of Arich Anpin of Atzilut. And root-soul-body of Arich Anpin clothe in Abba, and so on in this manner. 5. Adam Kadmon and ABYA are each included in the other, and there is Adam Kadmon and ABYA within Adam Kadmon, and Adam Kadmon and ABYA within Atzilut, and Adam Kadmon and ABYA within Beria, and so in Yetzira and Asiya. Arich Anpin is the discernment of Adam Kadmon that is not attained. Abba is Atzilut. Ima is Beria. Zeir Anpin is Yetzira. Nukva is Asiya. From Atzilut souls are drawn, from Beria spirits, and in Yetzira angels, and in Asiya Ofanim. 6. Man includes Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya from the four worlds ABYA, since in each of these discernments there are Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya. And the Neshama of Nefesh is more important than the light of Nefesh of Ruach. 7. It is possible to also merit the Nefesh of Atzilut, and even higher, and one who merits the Ruach of Yesod of Atzilut will be the husband of the Shechina. 8. Havaya in the filling of Av is the secret of the Yod of Havaya, which is the secret of Atzilut. And in the filling of Sag is the secret of the first Hei of Havaya, and the secret of Beria. And in the filling of Mah is the secret of the Vav of Havaya, and the secret of Yetzira. And in the filling of Ban is the secret of the lower Hei of Havaya, and the secret of Asiya. — Root-soul-body are attached to one another. Garment and palace separated from them.
items.html: *And now we will speak of the discernment of each of these worlds, what their matter is. 1Know, that the root, the souls, and the bodies are one discernment, between which there is no separation, but the garments and the palaces are two discernments separate from the three aforementioned discernments, and between these two, namely between the bodies and the garments, there is the dwelling of the shells, and they are literally attached to the rear of the light of the body.

items.heading: Root-soul-body are inner vessels, in which the more external is more inferior. Garment and palace are surrounding vessels, in which the more external is more important, and therefore the shells are found between the body and the garments, which is the place of darkness and greater inferiority.
items.html: And the reason for this is, that the three inner discernments have within them inner light, and the more inferior part of the inner light comes out into the skin, and there it ends. 2But the surrounding light is the opposite, for the more external light is greater, as is known. It follows, that the surrounding light of the innermost garment, which is attached to the body, is the smallest surrounding light of them all. Therefore the shells dwell there in the middle, in the place where there is neither inner light nor surrounding light, and it is in the middle between the inner and the surrounding, and that place is called the place of darkness. And this matter applies in every world, regarding the discernment of the shell that is in that world.

items.heading: When the countenances of Adam Kadmon and ABYA clothe one within another, each clothes only in three discernments: root, soul, body, which are attached together, and the ten Sefirot of the bodies do not clothe in the ten Sefirot of the garments.
items.html: But after we have explained the matter in detail, let us speak of it in general, and it is, that it is known, that within the innermost part of Adam Kadmon is Ein Sof, which clothes in the root of the souls of the ten Sefirot within it, and these clothe in the discernment of the souls of all the ten Sefirot within it, and these clothe in the ten Sefirot of the discernment of the body of Adam Kadmon. And it would have been fitting that the ten Sefirot of the bodies clothe in the ten Sefirot of the garments, but it is not so, for the aforementioned reason; rather, the three discernments of Atik of Atzilut surround these three discernments of Adam Kadmon.

items.heading: Root-soul-body of Adam Kadmon clothe within root-soul-body of Atik of Atzilut, and root-soul-body of Atik of Atzilut clothe in root-soul-body of Arich Anpin of Atzilut. And RSB of Arich Anpin clothe in Abba, and so on in this manner.
items.html: How so? Behold, the ten Sefirot of the bodies of Adam Kadmon clothe within the ten Sefirot of the roots of the souls of the ten Sefirot of Atik of Atzilut, and these clothe in the ten Sefirot of the discernment of the souls of Atik of Atzilut, and these clothe in the ten Sefirot of the bodies of Atik of Atzilut. And in the same way, the discernments of the roots, souls, and bodies of Arich Anpin clothe the bodies of Atik. And in the same way, the three discernments of Abba clothe Arich Anpin. And so the three discernments of Ima clothe Abba. And the three discernments of Zeir Anpin clothe Ima. And the three discernments of Nukva clothe Zeir Anpin. And so now all the discernments of the bodies, up to the Nukva of Zeir Anpin, have been completed.

items.heading: Adam Kadmon and ABYA are each included in the other, and there is Adam Kadmon and ABYA within Adam Kadmon, and Adam Kadmon and ABYA within Atzilut, and Adam Kadmon and ABYA within Beria, and so in Yetzira and Asiya. Arich Anpin is the discernment of Adam Kadmon that is not attained. Abba is Atzilut. Ima is Beria. Zeir Anpin is Yetzira. Nukva is Asiya. From Atzilut souls are drawn, from Beria spirits, and in Yetzira angels, and in Asiya Ofanim.
items.html: *Know, that the world of Atzilut includes all four worlds ABYA, and so Beria includes all of ABYA, and so Yetzira and so Asiya, in this manner: for Abba is Atzilut, and Ima is Beria, Zeir Anpin is Yetzira, and Nukva is Asiya. And the discernment of Arich Anpin is not discernible in any world, since it is very concealed. And behold, 3from the world of Atzilut come souls, and from Beria holy spirits, and from Yetzira angels, and from Asiya Ofanim.

items.heading: Man includes Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya from the four worlds ABYA, since in each of these discernments there are Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, and the Neshama of Nefesh is more important than the light of Nefesh of Ruach.
items.html: And behold, man includes the four worlds, and if he has merited only the Nefesh of Asiya, and afterward sinned, and blemished it, and it entered into the shells, they say to him, "the gnat preceded you," for the gnat did not act to enter into the shell. And if he did not sin, then he is in the secret of the Ofanim, and sometimes it will be that he has in him only the discernment of 4Nefesh, and he is more important than one who has Ruach, such as one who has the discernment of Neshama within Nefesh. As is known, that in every world, all four are included within it, and this man, once he has begun to shine, and to correct little by little, immediately the discernment of Neshama within Ruach of Yetzira shines within him, although it has not yet clothed within him completely, for it is impossible for it to clothe within him completely, until he corrects his Nefesh completely. And indeed, this man, who has Ruach within him, which is the discernment of Nefesh within Ruach of Yetzira, is certainly inferior to this aforementioned discernment.

items.heading: It is possible to also merit the Nefesh of Atzilut, and even higher, and one who merits the Ruach of Yesod of Atzilut will be the husband of the Shechina.
items.html: It is also possible that man will have the Nefesh of Atzilut, and even higher as well, and if he has Ruach from the discernment of Yesod of Atzilut, he will be the husband of the Matronita, and is called a man of God.

items.heading: Havaya in the filling of Av is the secret of the Yod of Havaya, which is the secret of Atzilut. And in the filling of Sag is the secret of the first Hei of Havaya, and the secret of Beria. And in the filling of Mah is the secret of the Vav of Havaya, and the secret of Yetzira. And in the filling of Ban is the secret of the lower Hei of Havaya, and the secret of Asiya.
items.html: *The four letters of Havaya are in the four worlds Atzilut, Beria, Yetzira, Asiya: Yod in Atzilut, the secret of the name 5Av of Yudin, for all was made in Hochma. Hei in Beria, the name Sag, for Ima nests in the throne. Vav in Yetzira, the name Mah, for six Sefirot nest in Yetzira. Lower Hei in Asiya, the name Ban, for Malchut nests in the Ofan.
